days.title: Saint Paul in Prison
days.alt: The aged Paul sits in a stone cell, one hand at his chin and the other on a book, in a shaft of light from a high window.
days.look: Look again at Paul in his cell, in the light from the window. What would you tell God about this search, in your own words?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Carl Bloch - The Sermon on the Mount.jpg
days.title: The Sermon on the Mount
days.alt: Listeners in robes and headscarves sit close together on the hillside, their faces turned up toward Jesus as he teaches.
days.look: Look again at the listeners with their faces turned to him. What are you most afraid you will lack?
days.license: Artist died 1890; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Gelijkenis van de rechter die wordt lastiggevallen door een klagende vrouw, RP-P-OB-46.028.jpg
days.title: The Parable of the Unjust Judge
days.alt: In an engraving, a woman in a long cloak comes forward to the seated judge and his court, with a town behind them.
days.look: Look again at the woman who keeps coming forward. Where are you tempted to stop asking?
days.license: Artist died 1712; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Our Lady of Vladimir
days.alt: In a gold-ground icon, Mary holds her child close, his cheek pressed against hers, and looks out with a tender, sorrowful gaze.
days.look: Look again at the child’s cheek pressed to his mother’s. What would it mean to rest in a love that does not forget you?

days.file: Simeon in the temple, by Rembrandt van Rijn.jpg
days.title: Simeon’s Song of Praise
days.alt: In a dim temple, the old man Simeon holds the swaddled Christ child in a pool of light, with Mary and Joseph beside him.
days.look: Look again at the light falling on the old man and the child. What are you still waiting for God to show you?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: William de Brailes - Top - Ruth Meets Boaz as she gleans (Ruth 2 -4-16) - Walters W10618R - Full Page.jpg
days.title: Ruth Meets Boaz as She Gleans
days.alt: Ruth bends over the field gathering ears of grain behind the reapers, while Boaz speaks to her.
days.look: Look again at Ruth stooping to gather what the reapers leave. What honest work could you take up today, however small?
days.license: 13th-century work; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: The parable of the wise and foolish virgins (SM 895).png
days.title: The Parable of the Wise and Foolish Virgins
days.alt: Young women stand at a doorway holding lit lamps, with Saint Peter beside them holding his keys.
days.look: Look again at the lamps, and at who has come prepared. What one careful question could you ask before you say yes?
days.license: Artist died 1862; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: Public Domain Mark, Städel Museum)

days.file: Aquila en zijn vrouw Priscillia, St.Paulus te Corinthe bij de tentmaker.jpg
days.artist: Raphael Sadeler I, after Joos van Winghe
days.title: Aquila and Priscilla Receive Paul at Corinth
days.alt: Paul works at a table beside Priscilla at her spinning wheel, in a busy workshop at Corinth.
days.look: Look again at Paul at work beside Priscilla in the busy workshop. Whom could you ask for help, or an introduction, this week?

days.file: Nicolaes Maes - Old Woman Saying Grace - WGA13820.jpg
days.title: Old Woman Saying Grace
days.alt: An old woman sits at a simple table with folded hands and bowed head, giving thanks before her meal.
days.look: Look again at the old woman’s folded hands over her plain meal. What can you thank God for today, before the answer comes?
days.license: Artist died 1693; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain, Web Gallery of Art)
